comment: Each entry suppresses one (cve + package + vulnerable_versions) triple from the High/Critical fail-the-build path. The reEvalDate is enforced: on every scheduled run the parser fails (or surfaces an issue) for any entry whose date is in the past, regardless of severity, forcing the maintainer to either re-justify (push the date out with a fresh rationale) or remove the entry (because the dep was bumped). See docs/security-audit-public-2026-04.md §11 limitation 4 footnote for the policy.

entries.rationale: Tracked as audit finding R-N1 (High) and as task #239. The DoS trigger is a crafted *route pattern* registered at server startup, not a crafted incoming request: every Express route in artifacts/api-server is an author-defined string constant (see routes/*.ts), so a malicious route pattern would have to be merged into the codebase and code-reviewed before it could ship. No user-controlled input ever reaches path-to-regexp's pattern-compilation surface at runtime. Accepted as residual risk until task #239 pins past 8.4.0; re-eval matches the §R-0 row.

Companion advisory to CVE-2026-4926 on the same path-to-regexp version range; same reachability argument applies (multi-wildcard ReDoS requires a crafted route *pattern*, not a crafted request). Closed in lockstep with CVE-2026-4926 by task #239. Re-eval matches the §R-0 row for R-N1.
